items.name: scroll-carousel
items.title: Scroll Carousel
items.description: A carousel on native scrolling with CSS scroll snap: the structure of shadcn's Carousel, no layout script, 3.4 kB for the core.

items.name: product-row
items.title: Product Row
items.description: Product tiles, 1.4 to 4 per view by container width, paged by view, arrows, dots and mouse drag.

items.name: brand-teasers
items.title: Brand Teasers
items.description: Teasers with an image, a logo tile over its corner and a dark text panel, three per view, two pixels apart.

items.name: hero-autoplay
items.title: Hero with Autoplay
items.description: Full-width slides that move on every 5 seconds, with a pause button, dots, and a fade back to the first slide after the last.

items.name: image-gallery
items.title: Image Gallery
items.description: One image in the centre with the neighbours showing, a dot per image, opening on the third.

items.name: logo-belt
items.title: Logo Belt
items.description: Logos as wide as they are, scrolled freely without snapping, draggable with a mouse.

items.name: scroll-sheet
items.title: Scroll Sheet
items.description: Bottom sheets, side drawers and dialogs on a native modal <dialog> and CSS scroll snap: opens before hydration, drags natively, 2.6 kB for the core.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A drop-in for the shadcn/ui Drawer on @nordwerk/scroll-sheet: the same exports and the props of both the Vaul and the Base UI drawer, on a native <dialog> with native dragging. Opens before hydration; about 6 kB of JavaScript with its library, against 22 kB (Vaul) and 39 kB (Base UI).

items.name: size-picker
items.title: Size Picker
items.description: A bottom sheet that opens at half the screen with a list of sizes, an engraving field kept above the iOS keyboard, and the add button at the bottom edge.

items.name: filter-drawer
items.title: Filter Drawer
items.description: Brand filters in a bottom sheet on phones and a drawer from the end edge on wide screens, with reset and a sticky result button.

items.name: mini-cart
items.title: Mini Cart
items.description: The bag in a drawer from the end edge with items, total and checkout; closes other sheets when it opens.

items.name: store-finder
items.title: Store Finder
items.description: A list of stores in a bottom sheet that rests at a third, two thirds or the full height.

items.name: mobile-menu
items.title: Mobile Menu
items.description: Navigation in a drawer from the start edge; the back button and back swipe close it.

items.name: contact-dialog
items.title: Contact Dialog
items.description: A centred dialog with a form that closes itself through method="dialog".

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: Images full screen in a dark dialog, with a scroll-carousel inside that opens at the picked image.

items.name: drawer-demo
items.title: Drawer Demo
items.description: The shadcn/ui Drawer calls unchanged on scroll-sheet: a bottom drawer, snap points with the page receding, a drawer from the right and one that cannot be dismissed.
